snippet.title: Super Sonic Battle 1.5 [SAGE '25 Trailer]
snippet.description:
Download Link on X/Twitter: @gin_developer

Full fledged Sonic Fighting game - Super Sonic Battle. Developed to celebrate the 20th Anniversary of the GBA title Sonic Battle!

1.5 MAJOR UPDATES:
- Improved Controller support overhaul (Native Support)
- Improved uniqueness in move sets
- Improved "Air" move sets
- Improved "Grab/Pummel" functionality
- Improved Life Icons for all characters
- Improved competitive balancing
- Improved AI Difficulty
- Improved various hitboxes to match animations
- Improved various sprite animations
- Several stages have been revamped
- Several characters have been revamped
- Several characters have had their Character Select mugshots revamped
- 8 New Characters (Classic Super Sonic, Classic Metal Sonic, Sticks, Trip, Tikal, Zavok, Sage, Infinite)
- 7 New Stages (Doomsday, Death Egg, Emerald Coast, Westopolis, Egg Rocket, Casino Paradise, Tiny Chao Garden)
